what: The hidden truth this scenario's simulator plays as the real hardware. Only the simulator that makes the measurements reads it (the scenario's RealWorld); identification never does (sysid/tests/test_noise_ladder.py holds the identify function to that), and the description's nominal gap is a datasheet's.
structure: gear_backlash's UR plant wrapped by BacklashModel with SituationConfig(gap_arcmin=10, zero='center', method='passive_joint'): one 10 arcmin gap on every joint (the stock situation sets one value for all six), the encoder zero mid-gap
